headlines.title: Jensen Huang's return, neocloud risk, and a holiday retail rally
headlines.snippet: In this special edition of Sozzi Unleashed: At The Close, Brian Sozzi warns that investors can be right about a tech revolution and still lose a fortune, lays out three reasons Nvidia may deserve another look after Jensen Huang's return, and explains why the debt-fueled neoclouds like CoreWeave and Nebius still make him nervous. Former federal prosecutor Gil Soffer, head of corporate investigations at Katten, joins to discuss how Nvidia's board probe proceeds with Huang back in charge and whether he could be fired again. Brian also connects the dots on the AI build-out and inflation with a clip from Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee, and makes the case for a strong holiday season for retailers with comments from Walmart CFO John David Rainey and Gap CEO Richard Dickson.

headlines.title: Ten reasons the market is selling off again before Thanksgiving
headlines.snippet: Sozzi Unleashed host Brian Sozzi runs through his list of 10 reasons stocks are selling off again two days after the Jensen Huang relief rally, from a hot PCE report and a possible December Fed hike to new tariffs of up to 20% on China and the EU, and five reasons Nvidia is back under pressure. He questions why Wall Street is shrugging off blowout quarters from Dell and HPE, with HPE CEO Antonio Neri weighing in on server pricing and why the company won't finance neoclouds. Yorkville Ives partner Dan Ives joins to argue the selloff is a growth scare, not a bubble, puts fair value on Anthropic as it trades below its IPO price, and previews Huang's testimony in Washington. Brian closes with Walmart's CFO on turkey sales, a look at retail stocks as gas prices fall for 31 straight days, and a Thanksgiving message to investors.

headlines.title: Tariffs are back as Anthropic sinks further below its IPO price
headlines.snippet: The 8:30 hosts Julie Hyman and Jake Conley, joined on the couch by BD8 Capital Partners CEO and CIO Barbara Doran, tackle the top stories of the day. Including the Trump administration's sweeping new Section 301 tariffs of 20% on China and dozens of other economies, in-line PCE inflation and a third-quarter GDP revision up to 4.3% that keep a December Fed hike in play, Anthropic sliding toward $78 and well below its $83 IPO price, and whether Jensen Huang is the right leader for Nvidia in a new regulatory era.
